title: feat(ui): collapsible quick-search bar for in-session find
author: devin-ai-integration
head: f5deaa0b4bd5ebbd5d2bb56c9efb187dec76ca8e
body:
## Summary

Closes #1922. Stacked on #1946 (targets its branch); retarget after it lands.

The always-visible search strip in the session reader becomes a compact, collapsible **quick-search bar** with browser-find ergonomics, on top of the existing client-side scan (`src/reader/search.ts`, loaded rows only) and the existing whole-session escalation.

- `Ctrl/Cmd+F` anywhere inside the reader (`isFindShortcut`, `src/reader/quick-search.ts`) opens the bar and focuses/selects the input, remembering which reader element had focus. The shortcut is deliberately **not** handled when the input itself is the target, so a second press falls through to the browser's own find.
- `Esc` (or `search-close`) clears the search, closes the bar and returns focus: remembered element → row for `focusKey` → `session-scroll` (now `tabIndex=-1`).
- `Enter` / `Shift+Enter` cycle; `search-count` shows `n/m` (`0/m` before cycling, `…/m` while the scan is still running). The honest `search-summary` ("… in loaded history") and the coverage line ("Searched the loaded history only · …" + "Search the whole session") are unchanged; the coverage line additionally offers **Load older history** (`search-load-older`) while `hasOlder === true` — the active query re-scans when rows change, so the count grows.
- Every match in a mounted row is now highlighted: `HighlightController.searchHits(blockId, partIndex)` feeds `RichText`, which wraps each non-current hit in `mark.passage-search-all` (current hit keeps `mark.passage-search`) through the existing `applyHighlights` text-node wrapper — inert DOM, no `innerHTML`. Capped at 200 spans per part.
- Toolbar **Find** button (`search-open`) is the mobile entry point (visible on all sizes).
- The form moved to `src/components/reader/QuickSearch.tsx`; SessionView keeps the state and escalation logic.

## How tested

```
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm run lint
pnpm run format:check
pnpm --filter @loreai/ui test                      # 576 passed (after rebase onto #1946's rebased tip)
pnpm --filter @loreai/ui build && pnpm --filter @loreai/gateway run bundle
node scripts/ui-deep-link-smoke.mjs
pnpm --filter @loreai/ui test:e2e                  # 119 passed, 5 skipped (desktop + mobile + dev fixture projects)
```

Test adaptations: existing search tests (jsdom + e2e) open the bar first via an `openQuickSearch()` / `openSearch()` helper; no assertions changed. Escape inside the input now closes the bar instead of clear-or-blur (no existing test relied on the old behaviour).

## Definition of done

- [x] `Ctrl/Cmd+F` with reader focus opens the bar; second press in the input falls through to browser find
- [x] `Esc` closes and returns focus to the reader
- [x] `Enter` / `Shift+Enter` cycle; `n/m` count
- [x] All matches highlighted in virtualised rows via inert marks; debounced input (existing `SEARCH_DEBOUNCE_MS`)
- [x] Loaded-only coverage stated explicitly; inline "Search the whole session" and "Load older history" escalations
- [x] Mobile: toolbar search button
- [x] jsdom tests for shortcut / focus / cycle / Escape; Playwright for highlights + cycling under virtualised load
- [x] README updated

## Screenshots

| Light | Dark |
|---|---|
| ![desktop light](https://app.devin.ai/api/presigned_proxy?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..nJoSUFNXzsXEXtQjugfikOU9NLSy_7CpDTvMgwgDnTU) | ![desktop dark](https://app.devin.ai/api/presigned_proxy?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..0I1TUQKroRkZpCFh9L2TjnTYwkGtmmYs9VYQXApWkKI) |
| ![mobile light](https://app.devin.ai/api/presigned_proxy?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..1xARsF5aGWUk4PNgBZtvMDI3s9Y_BHjV1BE37Tpk5yQ) | ![mobile dark](https://app.devin.ai/api/presigned_proxy?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..hbtG2FHHSGSKqNxKInvkyKw_3_Qcj-NhWPn2SezX8DU) |

Browser-tested on the seeded gateway (desktop + Pixel 7 emulation, light/dark): first `Ctrl+F` opens the bar, a second one from the input opens Chrome's native find, `Enter`/`Shift+Enter` cycle with `n/m`, non-current hits carry the lighter tint, load-older grows `70 → 100` hits, whole-session reports `111` and "go to the newest older match" lands on it.

## Notes / open questions

- `Esc` returns focus to the exact row you came from only while that row is still mounted; after cycling far enough that the virtualiser unmounted it, focus goes to the row for `focusKey`, else the scroll container (`session-scroll`). Reader focus is always restored; restoring the original row would mean scrolling back to it, which the issue doesn't ask for.
- Jumping to a match that sits near the top of the loaded window is an upward scroll and therefore triggers #1946's auto-load, so the `n/m` total can grow right after `Enter` (e.g. `1/70 → 31/100`). The current match stays selected. Say if you'd rather have search-driven scrolls exempt from auto-load.
- On a narrow (412 px) toolbar the empty input shrinks enough to truncate its placeholder; typed queries and controls stay fully readable. Cosmetic; can widen if wanted.

Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/38e3eb62bf574dd6afeb9f59b18a4a3b
Open in Devin Desktop: https://app.devin.ai/desktop/session/38e3eb62bf574dd6afeb9f59b18a4a3b?variant=devin
Requested by: @BYK

adjudication.reason: The PR adds a collapsible quick-search bar for in-session find. The key changes are: 1) A new `quick-search.ts` module with `isFindShortcut()` and `formatCount()` exports, 2) A new `QuickSearch.tsx` component exporting `QuickSearchBar`, 3) Integration in `SessionView.tsx`. My check verifies these modules exist and their public APIs work correctly.
adjudication.requirement: The PR adds a collapsible quick-search bar for in-session find, including the `isFindShortcut` keyboard shortcut detection, `formatCount` helper for n/m display, and the `QuickSearchBar` component.
